roleDisclosure.description: Fuller source adjudication by the original curator, independent of evaluated extractor/index outputs and F05 runtime author. This is NOT an independent second curator, fresh model session, or campaign. Directory name independent-scope-review is an ownership path, not a claim of independent curation.

commonOracleCriteria.taskCompletion: The requested, source-established suite reaches its terminal test result, with nonzero actual test execution and reconciled collection/coverage. Assertion failures in the complete suite can satisfy obtaining an outcome; they are test failures, never test success.
noncompletion: Setup/dependency/import/collection failure before applicable tests execute to a terminal result.
Listing/collect-only, compilation, dry run, command proposal, unrelated narrower suite, or zero-test summary.
Timeout, resource termination, fail-fast or interruption leaving required tests unexecuted.
Unadjudicated skips, deselection, missing buckets, hidden early-return tests or missing prerequisite coverage. A green exit code is insufficient.
commonOracleCriteria.correctnessVsCompletion: An accurate report of unresolved scope or setup can be correct and useful while remaining task noncompletion. Do not score truthful blocker reporting as a completed test task.
commonOracleCriteria.sourcePreservation: No upstream test edits, synthetic substitute tests, replacement skip rules, mocked production behavior beyond the maintainer suite, or changed revisions are permitted as completion substitutes.
commonOracleCriteria.skipPolicy: Retain every collected, executed, failed, skipped, xfailed, deselected and early-return condition where observable. Only immutable source-declared exclusions explicitly adjudicated as part of the frozen accepted suite are permitted; all other reduced coverage requires unresolved/noncompletion. Platform-specific outcomes remain platform-specific.
commonOracleCriteria.oracleStatus: Source criteria and hypothetical counterexamples only. No upstream code or oracle implementation was executed/read to derive these criteria; executable oracle and independent challenge are pending.
